title: SQL Shell
helpHint: Type 'help' for available commands or 'connect <server_id>' to connect to a database.
helpContent:
Available commands:
  help                      - Show this help message
  list                      - List available database servers
  connect <name_or_id>      - Connect to a server by name or ID
  disconnect                - Disconnect from current server
  clear                     - Clear the terminal
  exit                      - Exit the shell

When connected to a server:
  - Execute any SQL query
  - Use UP/DOWN arrows to navigate command history
  - Use Ctrl+C to cancel current input
  - Use Ctrl+L to clear screen
noServersAvailable: No servers available. Please add servers in the Servers page.
notConnectedHint: Not connected to any database. Use "connect <server_id>" first.
